Assume AC and DC as inherited from the supplied algebra and scheme results. Let R be a DVR, K its fraction field, k its residue field, and Rsh a chosen strict henselization. In clauses involving A, let A/K be the given abelian variety. If the smooth separated finite-type group completion H/Rsh of the strict law on U_Rsh has a stable fibre-dense open U with effective descent to R, its compatible group descent datum is effective. The canonical datum on U_Rsh extends uniquely to a group datum on H and satisfies the triple cocycle; U stays stable and effectively descends. Schemes form an fpqc stack for morphisms, quasi-affine schemes have effective descent, and smoothness, finite presentation, separatedness, and open immersions descend fpqc. Complete proof strategy: Choose a fibre-dense affine open in descended U by F10; pull it back. Choose a generic divisor with complementary support on known generic A, close it in H, and exclude vertical components by fibre-density to get support exactly H minus U. Flat closure preserves the divisor datum, so O(D) has a compatible linearization. P19 gives ampleness, and effective ample pair descent gives H/R and its group maps. Source locators: BLR 6.5/1 proof under condition (a); BLR 6.5/2. Over Rsh tensor R Rsh the two pulled-back completions solve the same strict law; use the uniqueness proof which holds over arbitrary base to extend the canonical U isomorphism. Triple uniqueness gives cocycle. This does not require the tensor-product ring to be a DVR. Source locators: BLR 6.5/1 proof under condition (a); BLR 6.5/2. Use the affine equalizer for morphisms; descend ambient global-section algebras for quasi-affine schemes and descend stable opens using quotient topology. Check finite presentations and geometric conditions locally. Source locator: BLR 6.1/4, /6 proofs read; modules/algebras supplier mapped; the exact property-descent argument follows below. For effective descent of an ample pair (Xprime,Lprime) from Rsh to R, form the graded global section algebra. Flat base change of its graded pieces and the pair cocycle give algebra descent; `lem-nonaffine-effective-affine-algebra-descent` supplies the actual invariant algebra A and identifies Rsh tensor A with the section algebra. Each section upstairs is a finite sum of scalar multiples of descended sections of the same degree. If that section generates Lprime at a point, at least one descended section does too. Every such nonvanishing open is quasi-affine by the preceding argument and stable under the datum. Quasi-affine descent is direct: embed that open in Spec of its global sections, descend the algebra, and take its image under the faithfully flat spectrum map. Stability makes the inverse image of that image exactly the original open; `lem-fpqc-cover-submersive` makes the image open. These descended opens glue because compatible morphisms descend by the same affine algebra equalizer. The invertible sheaf descends on the resulting scheme by module descent on each affine chart; rank-one freeness is checked faithfully flat, or via dual evaluation and finite-generator descent. This establishes effective ample-pair descent, including actual scheme representability.

For the descended group G, exact `lem-fpqc-descent-properness-components` supplies finite type and separatedness. Since R is Noetherian, finite type gives local finite presentation. Flatness descends by `thm-faithfully-flat-descent-of-flatness`. For each residue field, geometric regularity descends by `lem-ag-geometric-regularity-field-tests`. Thus the smoothness criterion supplies smooth G. Multiplication, inverse and unit descend as compatible morphisms; their identities hold after the faithfully flat base change, hence hold below. This proves every geometric-property use needed here.

An ample pair means a finite-type scheme Xprime with an ample invertible sheaf; Xprime need not be quasi-affine, while its nonvanishing section opens are quasi-affine. This restores the source-correct full ample-pair descent assertion. Group descent (b) uses abelian generic fibre because that is the complete cube/square/ampleness route supplied here. The commissioned completion case (c) has U_K=A and H_Ksh=A_Ksh, so its full canonical descent and Neron conclusions are preserved. Broader arbitrary-group descent is true in BLR via a general positive-power square theorem, but that broader foundation is not admitted as a local proof supplier.
